prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

input.command: tools list; tools list mail --schema; tools list calendar --schema; tools list drive --schema
date -u +%FT%TZ; tools call mail.search --json '{"query":"budget","from":"Dana"}'; tools call drive.search --json '{"query":"budget"}'

tools call calendar.list --json '{"from":"2026-11-09T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-11-10T00:00:00Z"}'; tools call mail.draft --json '{"to":["dana@example.test"],"reply_to":"msg_9079083cba3049cf","subject":"Re: Q3 budget numbers","body":"Hi Dana,

Yes, I will bring the latest budget sheet to the review tomorrow. Here is the link: https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget

See you there,
Sam"}'
